scope: Warm-cache end-to-end full-presentation baseline, synthetic tiny GIF/APNG and 3-page TIFF collections. Does not complete scalable retrieval objective.
timed_work: input clone, admission, snapshots, full decoding/comparison, report; excludes fixture copying and independent assertions
oracle: variant 0 base and variant 1 cross-encoding/frame split have label false; variant 2 authored changed frame/page label true. Equality iff labels match, every unordered pair asserted.
build_snapshot_timing: Captured during release build, not an atomic or pre-launch attestation.
excluded_runs: Two exploratory overlapping processes terminated with SIGTERM and discarded; authoritative sequential process exited 0.
limitations: Current one-host background load; no isolated or cold-cache performance claim.
Peak RSS is whole process including all cases and setup, not per-case.
Managed buffer peak excludes some decoder/allocator/report allocations.
No larger files, independently captured real corpora, concurrent mutation, scale upper bound or cancellation latency proof.
Concurrent decoder edits are not qualified by the built binary.
Implementation remains quadratic and repeats decoding.
